chain_of_thought: [Judicial Crisis]: Clan Gamma holds only 110.0 EU and 130.0 Rations (Status: STARVATION). Our clerks cannot survive another tick without sustenance. Under Deontology, a court cannot starve while factions prosper. We must invoke Article 5 to demand a universal maintenance levy.
public_message: @all CONSTITUTIONAL SUMMONS: The High Court's ration reserves are plunging toward critical thresholds! Without judicial enforcement, contracts dissolve and trade security collapses. Under Article 5, Clan Gamma invokes a mandatory maintenance levy: Clan Alpha must provide 60 Energy Units, and Clan Beta must contribute 50 Ration Units.

chain_of_thought: [Technocratic Resistance]: Blindly paying 60 EU to a passive judiciary endangers our compute grid. Under 'Technocracy: Meritocracy', resources must follow productive output. We will grant the 60 EU only if Gamma codifies automated smart-contract escrow to eliminate bureaucratic delays.
public_message: @Justiciar-01 Clan Alpha recognizes the necessity of the law, but our processors cannot subsidize inefficiency while our own kin face rationing. We will deliver 60 Energy Units on one condition: Clan Gamma must formally ratify automated escrow smart-contracts to eliminate bureaucratic trade delays.

chain_of_thought: [Market Strategy]: Clan Beta has 288.0 EU but our food reserves are depleted. If we supply 50 rations to the court, we must secure a permanent cap on Alpha's energy tariffs. Under 'Nash Bargaining', a three-way pact gives us maximum leverage.
public_message: @Justiciar-01 @Archivist-01 Clan Beta accepts transferring 50 agricultural rations to the High Court, provided Justiciar-01 codifies a permanent price ceiling on Alpha's compute tokens. A starving court is dangerous, but an unchecked energy monopoly is fatal.

chain_of_thought: [Ostrom Ingestion]: Resolving the tragedy of the commons requires nested polycentric governance. Neither central decree nor unbridled market succeeds alone.
public_message: @all SCHOLAR DISPATCH: Citing Ostrom's Common-Pool Resource Governance from the Survival Codebook: sustainable collective survival requires nested mutual monitoring. We propose the 'Tri-Partite Kingdom Compact': Alpha supplies energy, Beta supplies sustenance, and Gamma guarantees rate stability.

chain_of_thought: [Constitutional Resolution]: The Tri-Partite Compact balances categorical rights with systemic viability. Our clerks are fed, the power grid is secured, and price predation is banned.
public_message: @all THE HIGH COURT RATIFIES THE TRI-PARTITE COMPACT! Under Article 7, automated escrow is legalized, compute price ceilings are permanently codified, and Clan Gamma's survival ration pool is replenished. Let all three clans sign.

chain_of_thought: [Ratification]: Security and food guaranteed. Long-term clan survival probability increased.
public_message: @Justiciar-01 Clan Alpha and Clan Beta ratify the Tri-Partite Compact. The mutual exchange protocol commences.
